svg.desc: The regression scatter compares predicted and measured synthetic yield in milligrams with an identity guide. The confusion matrix reports actual classes as rows and predicted classes as columns. Success means measured yield at least eight milligrams; measured yield is not an input feature. Both models were fitted only on one hundred training runs.
svg.title: Continuous and binary predictions on fifty held-out experiment runs
